description: Resource Type definition for AWS::SageMaker::Extension. An extension is a versioned software package that Amazon SageMaker HyperPod installs and manages on the nodes of a HyperPod cluster. For example, the sagemaker-observability extension collects metrics from your cluster.

ExtensionVersion.description: The version of the extension to install, such as 1.0.0. When you create the extension without a version, SageMaker HyperPod installs the latest generally available version. If the extension doesn't have a generally available version, you must specify one. If you remove this property from your template during a stack update, the installed version doesn't change. You can't downgrade an extension. To install an earlier version, delete the extension and create it again.
ExtensionVersion.markdownDescription:
The version of the extension to install, such as 1.0.0. When you create the extension without a version, SageMaker HyperPod installs the latest generally available version. If the extension doesn't have a generally available version, you must specify one. If you remove this property from your template during a stack update, the installed version doesn't change. You can't downgrade an extension. To install an earlier version, delete the extension and create it again.

ConfigurationValues.description: The configuration settings for the extension, as a JSON string. The settings must match the configuration schema for the extension version. For each setting that you don't specify, SageMaker HyperPod uses its default value. When you update the stack, SageMaker HyperPod applies the settings in the string to the current configuration. Settings that you leave out keep their current values. To restore the default value of a setting, set it to null. To write the settings as YAML or JSON in your template, use the Fn::ToJsonString intrinsic function with the AWS::LanguageExtensions transform. The JSON string can be up to 10,240 characters long.
